justification: Each milestone is solved on its own with earlier builds locked in, so the chain never optimises across periods; the alternative of solving every milestone greenfield shifts emissions by about +17 per cent and renewable share by about -7.7 percentage points.
Thirteen weeks spread through the year give about a quarter of its half-hours; no selection method or basis for these particular weeks is recorded anywhere in this fork.

With named weeks off the sample carries no deliberately included peak-demand or residual-peak week, so an extreme hour enters only if one of the thirteen happens to contain it; this matters most for the deep-cap runs where firming is scarce.
One reference year cycle means one realisation of wind, solar and demand weather; inter-annual variability is not explored anywhere in the campaign.
Gurobi barrier at the default 1e-8 tolerance rather than a relaxed one, so a reported optimum is a converged optimum; the cost is wall time, bounded by a ten-hour per-solve budget.

short_name: transport and storage adder on captured carbon
justification: A single flat price per tonne of captured carbon dioxide is applied in every chain and every year rather than a per-sink or per-year cost.
No AEMO input reaches 2060, so demand shape, wind and solar weather, hydro water and fuel availability are all 2050's; only the demand level and the carbon cap are authored for 2060.
